messages:
Ava: Quick idea 5: launch 'Desk Plant Passport' + cross-region postcard match next week. Leave a postcard, grab a plant ticket, swap stickers. :evergreen_tree: :postcard:
Devon: Love it. Can there be a 'no international' opt-out? shipping annoyances :grimacing:
Priya: I'll make a sign-up sheet. Columns: `Slack handle`, `Full name`, `City/Region`, `Can receive mail? (Y/N)`, `Plant or sticker?`, `Random pair? (Y/N)`. Link: http://tiny.redwood/winter-passport (placeholder)
Ethan: Happy to coordinate SF mailroom drop-offs and EU stamp runs if needed. Also can label packages for the office.
MailOps: HQ mailroom can accept pre-labeled envelopes, please use `WP-<slack>` on the outside and drop in the "Holiday Drop" box by reception. We can't forward international mail from the office.
Ava: Also planning a tiny postcard prompt: `Hi from [city]! Weird local fact:` keep it 1 line. Priya, can you make a printable sticker for those?
Priya: Yep, making a 2x2 sticker sheet and a postcard template. Will post PDF in #random later.
SleighBot: Reminder set: "Holiday Drop box opens" Mon 08:30 local. :bell:
Devon: Mini poll: which drink for the table? React with :coffee: for hot cocoa, :tea: for mulled cider, :tropical_drink: for chai.
Ethan: Also we should do a tiny kudos card for folks who've helped this year 5: I can print 30 of them.
Ava: Nice. Sign-ups close Friday EOD so we can print labels and map pairings. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
